summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for parsing delimiter-separated values into structured data. It differs semantically and functionally from peer candidates (custom delimiter instantiation, formatting/serialization, scale normalization) and from existing skills (Flink tokenization, codec derivation, text file ingestion). The candidate addresses input_transformation stage with clear parse-focused workflow. No existing skill covers this specific capability. Support evidence from d3-dsv API validates the approach.
